aftersales_cancellation_check.name: aftersales_cancellation_check
aftersales_cancellation_check.value:
"aftersales"."aftersales"."status" = 'cancelled' OR ("aftersales"."aftersales"."cancel_reason" IS NULL AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."cancelled_at" IS NULL
        AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_kept" IS NULL AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."freight_kept" IS NULL
        AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."compensation_kept" IS NULL AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."other_cost_kept" IS NULL)

aftersales_product_cost_conversion_check.name: aftersales_product_cost_conversion_check
aftersales_product_cost_conversion_check.value:
("aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_usd" IS NULL OR "aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost" IS NOT NULL)
        AND (("aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_rate" IS NULL) = ("aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_rate_date" IS NULL))
        AND (("aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_rate" IS NULL) = ("aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_rate_source" IS NULL))
        AND ("aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_rate" IS NULL OR ("aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_rate" > 0 AND coalesce("aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_currency" <> 'USD', false)))
        AND ("aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_usd" IS NULL OR "aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_currency" <> 'USD' OR "aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_usd" = "aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost")
        AND ("aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_usd" IS NULL OR "aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_currency" = 'USD' OR "aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_rate" IS NOT NULL)

        OR ("channel"."store_mailbox"."provider" = 'qiye163' AND "channel"."store_mailbox"."imap_host" IS NOT NULL AND "channel"."store_mailbox"."imap_port" BETWEEN 1 AND 65535)

ticket_message_no_reply.value:
("ticket"."ticket_message"."no_reply_by_id" IS NULL AND "ticket"."ticket_message"."no_reply_by_name" IS NULL AND "ticket"."ticket_message"."no_reply_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("ticket"."ticket_message"."no_reply_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket"."ticket_message"."no_reply_by_name" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket"."ticket_message"."no_reply_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ticket"."ticket_message"."direction" = 'inbound')

aftersales.aftersales_cost.definition:
SELECT aftersales_id, store_id, fee_date, responsibility,
  product_cost_usd::numeric(12, 2) AS product_cost_usd, freight_usd::numeric(12, 2) AS freight_usd, compensation_usd::numeric(12, 2) AS compensation_usd, other_cost_usd::numeric(12, 2) AS other_cost_usd,
  (coalesce(product_cost_usd, 0) + coalesce(freight_usd, 0) + coalesce(compensation_usd, 0) + coalesce(other_cost_usd, 0))::numeric(12, 2) AS total_usd
FROM (
  SELECT "aftersales"."aftersales"."id" AS aftersales_id, "aftersales"."aftersales"."store_id" AS store_id,
    "aftersales"."aftersales"."fee_date" AS fee_date, "aftersales"."aftersales"."responsibility" AS responsibility,
    CASE WHEN "aftersales"."aftersales"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_kept" IS NOT TRUE THEN 0 ELSE "aftersales"."aftersales"."product_cost_usd" END AS product_cost_usd,
    CASE WHEN "aftersales"."aftersales"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."freight_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."freight_kept" IS NOT TRUE THEN 0 ELSE "aftersales"."aftersales"."freight_usd" END AS freight_usd,
    CASE WHEN "aftersales"."aftersales"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."compensation_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."compensation_kept" IS NOT TRUE THEN 0 ELSE "aftersales"."aftersales"."compensation_usd" END AS compensation_usd,
    CASE WHEN "aftersales"."aftersales"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."other_cost_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "aftersales"."aftersales"."other_cost_kept" IS NOT TRUE THEN 0 ELSE "aftersales"."aftersales"."other_cost_usd" END AS other_cost_usd
  FROM "aftersales"."aftersales"
  WHERE "aftersales"."aftersales"."status" <> 'pending_confirmation'
) AS counted
aftersales.aftersales_cost.name: aftersales_cost

ticket.customer_letter.definition:
SELECT "ticket"."ticket_message"."id" AS ticket_message_id, "ticket"."ticket_message"."ticket_id" AS ticket_id,
  "ticket"."ticket"."store_id" AS store_id, "ticket"."ticket"."site" AS site, "ticket"."ticket_message"."received_at" AS received_at,
  "ticket"."ticket_message"."channel" AS channel, "ticket"."ticket_message"."first_reply_at" AS first_reply_at, "ticket"."ticket_message"."sla_result" AS sla_result
FROM "ticket"."ticket_message"
JOIN "ticket"."ticket" ON "ticket"."ticket"."id" = "ticket"."ticket_message"."ticket_id"
WHERE "ticket"."ticket_message"."direction" = 'inbound' AND "ticket"."ticket_message"."source" = 'customer'
ticket.customer_letter.name: customer_letter

ticket.customer_trigger_event.definition:
SELECT "ticket"."status_change"."id" AS status_change_id, "ticket"."status_change"."ticket_id" AS ticket_id,
  "ticket"."ticket"."store_id" AS store_id, "ticket"."ticket"."site" AS site,
  "ticket"."ticket_message"."received_at" AS received_at, "ticket"."ticket_message"."channel" AS channel
FROM "ticket"."status_change"
JOIN "ticket"."ticket_message" ON "ticket"."ticket_message"."channel_message_id" = "ticket"."status_change"."channel_message_id"
JOIN "ticket"."ticket" ON "ticket"."ticket"."id" = "ticket"."status_change"."ticket_id"
WHERE ("ticket"."status_change"."event" = 'inbound_reopen' OR ("ticket"."status_change"."event" = 'inbound' AND "ticket"."status_change"."from_status" IS NULL))
  AND "ticket"."ticket_message"."direction" = 'inbound' AND "ticket"."ticket_message"."source" = 'customer'
ticket.customer_trigger_event.name: customer_trigger_event
